title: learning fuses as ideas melt congeal coalescing in communities as thought New Knowledge sparked on tips of past as spindles rekindle flames of desire
summary: learning fuses as ideas melt congeal coalescing in communities as thought New Knowledge sparked on tips of past as spindles rekindle flames of desire in fibers of unlit realities #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
learning fuses
    as ideas melt
congeal
     coalescing in communities
as thought

New Knowledge

sparked on tips
of past as
spindles
rekindle flames
of desire
in
fibers of
unlit realities
#smallpoems
